transforms.code:
# if property is listable, 'dropdown' param will be true (display the dropdown)
	
	return value['dropdown']

# return the dropdown options that were passed in as a param
	
	return value['options']

onChange.script:
# a listable property's value was changed
	
	if currentValue.value != None and str(origin) not in ['Binding','Script']:
		propVal = self.props.options[currentValue.value]['label']
		oldVal = self.view.params.rowData.value
		
		# if new value is selected, get value and property name, and send this info to propChange
		if propVal != oldVal:
			propName = self.view.params.rowData['underlyingName']
			propVal = self.props.options[currentValue.value]['label']

			# for pipeline properties, if '<None>' is selected, empty string needs to be sent to propChange
			if propName in ['ackPipeline','activePipeline','clearPipeline'] and propVal == '<None>':
				propVal = ''
			
			logger = system.util.getLogger('configurator.tablecell')
			logger.debug('dropdown selection changed; prop name= ' + propName + '; val= ' + str(propVal))
			
			payload = {'propName':propName,'propVal':propVal}
			system.perspective.sendMessage("propChange",payload=payload,scope="page")

# a non-listable property's value was changed
	
	propVal = currentValue.value
	oldVal = self.view.params.rowData.value
	if propVal != oldVal and str(origin) not in ['Binding','Script']:
		propName = self.view.params.rowData['underlyingName']
		propVal = currentValue.value
		
		foundDuplicateName = 0
		
		# if 'Name' property is changed, check the names of the other alarms for
		# this tag (cannot have duplicate alarm name on same tag)
		if propName == 'name':
			existingAlarmNames = self.view.params.rowData['existingAlarmNames']
			if propVal in existingAlarmNames:
				foundDuplicateName = 1
				system.perspective.openPopup("duplicate-alarm",'Exchange/Alarm Configurator/Framework/Popup', params = {'title':'Error','body':'This tag already has an alarm with this name: ' + str(propVal),'id':'duplicate-alarm'},showCloseIcon=False,draggable=False,viewportBound=True,overlayDismiss=True,modal=True)
		
		# if foundDuplicateName is 0, then either the 'Name' property was changed 
		# and the new name was unique, or a different non-listable property was 
		# changed and the new value was different than the old value; send the 
		# property name and property value to propChange
		if foundDuplicateName == 0:
			payload = {'propName':propName,'propVal':propVal}
			
			logger = system.util.getLogger('configurator.tablecell')
			logger.debug('text in the textfield has changed; prop name= ' + propName + '; val= ' + str(propVal))
			
			system.perspective.sendMessage("propChange",payload=payload,scope="page")
		else:
			self.refreshBinding('props.text')
